This configuration delivers the maximum achievable signal efficiency within all project constraints and is ready for deployment in the Level-1 trigger system.

requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L2 at 40 GeV achieves 92.1% signal efficiency, the highest performance among all tested configurations. Comprehensive threshold scans (20-60 GeV) for all viable algorithms confirm this is the maximum achievable efficiency. Operates at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate as verified by simulation.
